newsitem.title: USA: CVS has stock pact to acquire Revco - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: CVS has stock pact to acquire Revco - WSJ.

text.p: CVS Corp has reached a pact to acquire Revco D.S. Inc in a stock swap valued at more than $40 a share, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.
The paper, citing people familiar with the matter, said both companies' boards met earlier this week and approved the deal, pending agreement on some minor issues.
The report said the merger, which would create the second-largest drug store chain in the U.S. behind Walgreen, is expected to be announced as early as today.

It said CVS is expected to close Revco's headquarters in Twinsburg, Ohio, which has about 1,100 employees. It also said CVS expects it would have to sell about 100 stores in order to obtain anti-trust regulatory approval.
Last week Revco, the second largest U.S. drug store chain, and No. 5 CVS confirmed that they were in merger discussions.
Revco shares closed Thursday at 38, up 7/8. CVS shares closed down 1/4 at 44.
